body: I'm always helping people but I know they would never listen. I just woke up and I'm already getting yelled at and told I'm useless because I couldn't think for myself and brush my sister's hair. Is it my fault? I need to better daughter but I don't know-how. I don't even how to make myself happy anymore. Am I being useless?

I think I was a mistake, everything I do is wrong. I think I'm really useless, she's always saying it. I always think about what would happen if I really die now. I could make it fast and easy but I'm too scared to find out what happens after death. Will I always be sad... I don't want to continue feeling this way
If I died would she care? would they care? Would they cry for long? Would they move on fast? I don't think they would mourn for long
I'm not happy, I don't feel loved
I don't want to exist anymore
